_doc: Editor override for The Central Wisconsin Ten. Keyed by sport, values are { entries: [{ school_id, rank?, lede? }] }. rank pins the team's slot (1-based) and, if the school isn't in the algorithmic pool, pulls it in from anywhere. lede replaces the algorithmic sentence with your own. Missing overrides fall through cleanly — the poll runs on the WPR Power Index alone. Loaded via fetchJsonOptional in data/fetchDataset.js.
